overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: cancelled meetings, staff-prepared minutes from recordings, and the January 11 minutes were all held adequate. Extra allegations in the further-review request were declined.

allegations.summary: Council allegedly failed to hold meetings for which notices had been posted (January 11 notices for Feb 3, 7, 9 went unheld).
allegations.key_passage: The Open Meeting Law does not specify when or how meetings may be canceled, nor does it prohibit the cancelation of posted meetings.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Council violated the law by not holding a follow-up round table mentioned at the January 11 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: The Open Meeting Law applies when a public body holds a meeting but does not, in general, require that public bodies hold meetings.

allegations.summary: Minutes were allegedly created by a staff member who reviews recordings after the fact rather than attending the meetings.
allegations.key_passage: it does not specify how minutes must be created or by whom and does not prohibit a staff member from creating minutes after reviewing an audio or video recording of the meeting to be memorialized.

allegations.summary: Minutes of the January 11 meeting allegedly omitted most comments and concerns raised by attendees, so they were insufficient.
allegations.key_passage: Overall, although the minutes could have been more detailed, we find that the minutes include enough detail to meet the minimum requirements of the law.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged a public comment was misquoted in the January 11 minutes, changing its intent.
allegations.key_passage: Although the minutes do not capture every nuance of the Complainant’s comment, we find that the minutes accurately summarize this discussion.

allegations.summary: Allegations raised only in the request for further review, not in the original complaint filed with the Council, were not reviewed.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to review any allegations raised in the request for further review as they were not raised in a formal complaint filed with the Council.
